text:
ella: quick bring-up for cascade-14b-int6. finished smoke + GTN slices. want concise routing + scorecard recs for product/GTN.

omar: drop numbers pls

ella: p50 58ms, p95 240ms (4k batch), throughput ~610 tok/s, est cost $0.0031 per 1k toks vs int8 baseline $0.0069 per 1k toks

tess: ~55% cost delta, huge. quality?

ella: GTN 2k sample sweep: overall accuracy -0.7% abs, multi-turn planning -2.2%, numeric-extraction -1.1%, hallucination +0.8% on fine-grained QAs

ben: multi-turn planning -2.2 could hit workflows. where concentrated?

ella: mostly chain-of-thought math and API-edit style prompts. token-ppl slope rises after 1100 tokens -> long-context issues

ops-bot: candidate cascade-14b-int6 smoke -> metrics: cost_down, latency_tail_up, error_rate stable

omar: propose conservative rollout: 15% live to non-high-assurance short-context flows; 100% int8 for code/legal/finance; cap max_context to 1024 on int6; shadow 50% for monitoring

tess: detection rules? keyword heuristics + context_len ok to start but suggest training a small flow classifier once prod labels accumulate

ben: routing idea: default int6, if flow_tag in ["billing","legal","code"] or code_prob>0.65 -> int8; also if context_len>1024 -> int8. we have a cheap ngram code detector ready.

ella: agree. also recommend stream chunk size tuning (smaller chunks reduce p95 tail on int6) and KV cache limit to avoid thrash

omar: need a one-pager scorecard for PMs/GTN. suggested CSV columns: slice, sample_n, metric, int8_value, int6_value, delta_abs, delta_pct, accept_threshold, routing_rule, biz_risk_note

tess: add sample worst-case diffs (redacted) and a small ROI calc: expected $/M tokens and monthly savings for mid-size & enterprise customers

ben: monitoring rules: alert on hallucination_delta > +1.2% OR p95 increase > +12% OR fallback_rate > 1% in 30m. auto-fallback to int8 on hallucination signal.

ella: one more technical note: quant artifacts visible in attention-head distributions on some pronoun-coref cases; may require per-layer bias correction later (tech debt).

ops-bot: flag created cascade-int6-canary. baseline snapshots saved at ts=3467890100

omar: timeline: ella posts CSV + one-pager tomorrow; ops implements flag + dashboards this week; start 15% canary Mon, review after 7d, expand to 40% if stable

tess: product messaging draft: "Cost-optimized inference tier for everyday workloads; fidelity tier (int8) retained for high-assurance flows." include explicit list of flows that remain fidelity by default

ben: PM ask: include per-slice business impact (revenue-sensitive, retention-risk) so GTN can prioritize signing-off on thresholds

ella: will attach CSV + 10 redacted examples after GTN review. thanks all. :raised_hands:

omar: +1. also add a short rollback playbook for PMs.

ops-bot: monitoring hooks registered: latency_by_variant, hallucination_rate_by_slice, fallback_rate, sample_capture_s3

ella: will schedule a 15-min sync with PMs to walk the one-pager after posting the CSV.
